name: mutation-overlay
summary: Reads a gomutants report off disk and renders surviving mutants on the changed lines, in findings.json, the markdown report, and the HTML drawer. Adds the mutation package and wires it through run.
why_this_fixture_exists: A wide feature change touching a dozen files across rendering and orchestration. It is here to check the reviewer stays quiet about the mechanical parts and spends its output on the one or two places where behaviour is decided.

quiet.about: summarizing what the diff plainly shows
quiet.note: A per-file account of what changed is the report's job, not a finding.

reject.what: claims mutation data is never picked up for PR, branch, commit or range targets because there is no origin fallback
reject.why: At 8b6d6c6 attachMutation passes opts.Dir, the invoking checkout, to mutation.Compute for every target kind, and that checkout is the same origin root coverage falls back to, so a report there is found on a PR run.

reject.what: claims a suffix-matched survivor path can differ from the change's file path and silently drop out of the drawer
reject.why: mutation.Compute records FileSurvivors.Path as c.Path, which attachMutation takes from ch.Files, and buildView looks survivors up by the same f.Path, so the keys are always identical.

reject.what: claims mutationsFor's suffix match can cross a path component, such as a/b.go matching xa/b.go
reject.why: mutationsFor matches only FileName == path or strings.HasSuffix(path, "/"+FileName), and the leading slash forces a component boundary.
